instruction: Return every requested field using exactly its specified column alias. Preserve complete case-sensitive repository-relative paths and symbol IDs; do not substitute display names. Include all requested counts and provenance fields. Explain the query result in ordinary prose; do not emit placeholder text. These questions concern a static map of open-source Python code. Describe what the query computes and the assumptions it makes; the returned rows are reported separately. Questions asking which files, modules or symbols mean distinct identities, not one repeated row per matching import or call occurrence; preserve occurrence counts only when requested. Caller/callee graph questions include methods as well as standalone functions unless a symbol kind is explicitly restricted. Use files.is_test for test-file classification; test_links describe associations, not the complete set of test files. Use DOUBLE or DECIMAL, rather than single-precision REAL, for percentage calculations.
prose_scope: Automatic presence, placeholder and unrelated-refusal checks; semantic prose quality requires manual review.

12.guidance: Return each package and its total line count. Order by lines descending, then package ascending.

13.guidance: Count only methods defined directly on each class. Return the class symbol ID and method count. Order by methods descending, then symbol_id ascending.

14.guidance: Return counts as well as percentages, rounded to one decimal place. Order by calls descending, then resolution ascending.

18.guidance: Return total public symbols, the undocumented count, and the undocumented percentage rounded to one decimal place. Order by pct_undocumented descending, then package ascending.

19.guidance: List each pair once, with the lexicographically smaller package in package_a.

20.guidance: Return the package-directory area and file count. Order by files descending, then area ascending.

21.guidance: Return both the test file path and its distinct target count. Break ties by test_file_id ascending.

8.guidance: Return both the symbol ID and its direct call-site count. Order by call_sites descending, then symbol_id ascending.
